name: Art3m1sPSV
author: DeQxJ00
description: An Artemis Engine (cross-platform visual novel engine) game runner for PlayStation Vita, based on the third-party Art3m1s implementation. Parsing and runtime behavior are based on Alphaly2K/art3m1s-core, with PSV adaptations for some newer engine script behaviors, rendering, shader, resource caching, audio/video, and input.
